description: Header file providing utility functions for handling Python string objects, including checking, unpacking, packing, interning, and attribute access optimizations within the PyTorch codebase.

methods.name: THPUtils_checkString
methods.description: Checks if a PyObject is a bytes/str or unicode object.

methods.name: THPUtils_unpackString
methods.description: Unpacks a PyBytes or PyUnicode object into a std::string, decoding as UTF-8 for unicode.

methods.name: THPUtils_unpackStringView
methods.description: Unpacks a PyBytes or PyUnicode object into a std::string_view, decoding as UTF-8 for unicode.

methods.name: THPUtils_packString
methods.description: Creates a PyUnicode object from a C string or std::string.

methods.name: THPUtils_internString
methods.description: Interns a std::string as a Python unicode string.

methods.name: THPUtils_isInterned
methods.description: Checks if a Python unicode object is interned.

methods.name: THPUtils_internStringInPlace
methods.description: Interns a Python unicode object in place.

methods.name: PyObject_FastGetAttrString
methods.description: Fast attribute getter that avoids certain lookups and exceptions, optimized for Python 3.13+.
